tools.name: core_Orders_EtaStatesGet
tools.title: Get Orders Eta States
tools.description: The ETA rows recorded for one order's own stops in orderEtaStates[], oldest first by createdAt. Each row has stopId, type (PICKUP or DROPOFF), arrivesAt, departsAt and createdAt as "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS", plus eta, distance, duration and lateness. There is no location name or appointment window here, so pair it with core_Orders_Get for the stop. An order with nothing computed yet returns an empty list.
